description: Ministry of Lands & Parliament Reforms - Land Acquisition - Appointed Mr. M. Thikalarathne as an acquiring officer for Galewela D/S Division & Dambulla from 01.01.2018 to 31.12.2018
reasoning: This gazette notification primarily concerns land acquisition matters. It specifically appoints an officer for land acquisition activities related to the Dewahoowa Feeder Canal Development Project under the Land Acquisition Act. While it does mention a government minister and includes an appointment, the core subject matter is land acquisition for a specific development project, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4) rather than a government personnel classification. The appointment is specifically for land acquisition purposes and the content focuses on property/land matters rather than general government structure or personnel changes.
